say:1:1028327001:1.text: I have prepared all the other ingredients and can begin to make the smelling salts. Patience now, this cannot be rushed.
say:1:1028327001:1.source_cn: 其他的材料我都备好了，这就开始制作嗅盐。别急，年轻人，...

say:2:1028327002:1.text: Sir... my companion who mistakenly drank the elixir... will it have any lasting impact on him?
say:2:1028327002:1.source_cn: 老人家……我的同伴误喝了这药，不会对身体有什么影响吧？

say:3:1028327003:1.text: Oh no, nothing that hasn't already been done. Haha, it would make a very effective cure for insomnia.
say:3:1028327003:1.source_cn: 别的倒也没有什么，就是会睡得很沉，哈哈……治疗失眠的话...

say:6:1028327005:1.text: But if its only effect is to put people to sleep, why is it written that it's an elixir of "eternal youth?"
say:6:1028327005:1.source_cn: 可如果它的作用只有让人沉眠，为什么古老的石碑上记载着它...

say:7:1028327006:1.text: Hahaha, it's true that it can grant "eternal youth", but it's a bit of an exaggerated claim made by our ancestors.
say:7:1028327006:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，说它能“永葆青春”倒也没错，但那不过是祖先们夸...

choice_prompt:8:1028327006.text: Hahaha, it's true that it can grant "eternal youth", but it's a bit of an exaggerated claim made by our ancestors.
choice_prompt:8:1028327006.source_cn: 哈哈哈，说它能“永葆青春”倒也没错，但那不过是祖先们夸大的说法而已。

say:9:1028327007:1.text: The elixir does indeed slow the aging process, but only while the consumer lies in the sleep it induces.
say:9:1028327007:1.source_cn: 这种灵药会让人沉睡，衰老速度也跟着变慢，自然永葆青春。

say:12:1028327009:1.text: But this elixir is too potent. Without these smelling salts, an everlasting slumber is probable. At times, it's even been used as poison of sorts.
say:12:1028327009:1.source_cn: 但这药太猛烈，如果没有这种嗅盐，甚至真的会让人长眠不醒...

say:14:1028327011:1.text: Don't worry; as long as you wake him up in a timely manner, it won't do any harm.
say:14:1028327011:1.source_cn: 放心吧，只要及时唤醒就不会对身体有伤害。

say:16:1028327012:1.text: That said, the formula, in turn, has been improved upon and refined generation after generation.
say:16:1028327012:1.source_cn: 话说回来，这个药方，反倒是一代又一代人不断改良，做了点...

say:17:1028327013:1.text: Anesthetic ointments used to numb pain during the treatment of external wounds are derived from it.
say:17:1028327013:1.source_cn: 在治疗外伤时能麻醉伤患的麻醉药剂，就是根据这个药方拓展...

say:18:1028327014:1.text: Speaking of which, have you heard of calmflower tea? It can soothe the mind, and its formula is also derived from this recipe.
say:18:1028327014:1.source_cn: 还有的话……“安神花茶”，你们知道吧？能放松心神，也是...

say:19:1028327015:1.text: That's Parisa's favorite kind of tea! I told you the aroma was familiar.
say:19:1028327015:1.source_cn: 原来就是帕瑞莎最爱喝的那种茶！我就说觉得那股味道有点熟悉呢。

say:20:1028327016:1.text: Here, the smelling salts are done—take them! And next time, don't let anyone consume exotic elixirs at random.
say:20:1028327016:1.source_cn: 喏，嗅盐做好了，拿去吧！下次可不能再乱喝东西了啊！

say:21:1028327017:1.text: Got it... Thank you, kind sir!
